description: Get URLs associated with a domain, as discovered from mobile application analysis. Useful for finding API endpoints, web paths, and resources referenced by apps. Returns a list of full URLs. Results may include internal/staging endpoints that are not publicly indexed by search engines.

domain.description: A domain name to find associated URLs for (e.g. "example.com"). Do not include protocol (http/https) or paths.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: Number of results to skip before returning a page (default 0). Use this to retrieve results beyond the first page.

name: bevigil_get_urls
